name: letter_grades
prompt:
Write a complete Renyi program for the task below. Follow the cheat sheet exactly: no features it does not list. Give every public definition a `purpose:` clause and give pure functions `example:` lines. Answer with the program only, in one code fence.

Task: A library module that turns a list of scores (0 to 100) into letter grades A to F using the usual 90/80/70/60 cut-offs, plus a function that counts how many students got each grade.
